description:
Create a new Server Rack diagram in EdrawMax. 

1. From the Home screen or New menu, find and create a 'Rack Diagram' (under Network category).
2. Drag a '42U Cabinet' or 'Rack' frame onto the canvas.
3. Populate the rack with equipment from the Rack Equipment library, arranged from bottom to top:
   - Bottom (Units 1-4): One 'UPS' unit. Label it: 'APC Smart-UPS 3000'.
   - Above UPS: Three 'Server' units (2U each) stacked on top of each other. Label them: 'Web Server 1', 'Web Server 2', 'DB Server'.
   - Top section: One 'Patch Panel' and one 'Switch' (Switch below Patch Panel). Label the Switch: 'Cisco Switch'.
4. Add a title text box at the top of the diagram: 'Rack-B04 Elevation'.
5. Save the diagram as '/home/ga/Documents/rack_elevation.eddx'.
6. Export the diagram as a PNG image to '/home/ga/Documents/rack_elevation.png'.
